bias.en: Uptrend fading · SAR flipped bearish, back on the 200-day
bias.zh: 上升趋势减弱 · 抛物线 SAR 转空，回到 200 日均线

read.en: Tesla fell 3.3% on Nov 4 to $385.19, trading $375.50–392.04 on heavier volume. It is under the rising 5-day ($398.1) and 10-day ($394.1), just above the falling 200-day ($384.8) and above the rising 30-day ($378.0) and falling 100-day ($367.9). MACD has been above its signal since Oct 26, but the histogram is fading toward a cross; Parabolic SAR flipped bearish on Nov 4 ($414.23), and RSI is 51.
read.zh: 特斯拉 11月4日下跌 3.3%，收于 $385.19，盘中区间 $375.50–392.04，成交量放大。股价位于上行的 5 日（$398.1）和 10 日均线（$394.1）下方，略高于下行的 200 日均线（$384.8），并位于上行的 30 日（$378.0）和下行的 100 日均线（$367.9）上方。MACD 自 10月26日起位于信号线上方，但柱状图收窄、趋向交叉；抛物线 SAR 于 11月4日转为看空（$414.23），RSI 为 51。

read.en: The drop broke the $394–397.6 support (10-day, Nov 2–3 lows) and closed under the $388 cap, now resistance, while the 200-day held. Resistance is $387.5–388 ($388 cap, Oct 30 low), then $394.1–398.1 (10 and 5-day, Nov 3 low) and $404.2–406.5. Support is $384.8 (200-day), then $375.5–378 (30-day, Nov 4 low) and $368. A close above $388 would target $394–398; below $384.8, $375–378.
